scores.reason: card_get leads with pay per mile and a bonus in plain, short words, and the Spanish reads naturally. But it never names the carrier, the dry van freight, the coast-to-coast lanes, the home time, or that this is a team job. card_apply and "this seat is open" are a little generic.

card_get, card_need and card_apply all repeat the same filler line, so the three-card formula is not followed, and card_apply and primary_text are cut off mid-word. It is built of "dynamic team", "competitive pay" and "exciting opportunity", with only the $95,000 as a real detail. The Spanish is a word-for-word copy of the same filler.

card_get opens with the pay range, drop and hook and equipment; card_need lists the requirements; card_apply names Silvicom Inc. primary_text gives dedicated dry van, coast to coast and the no-split promise, but leaves out home time, and "more miles and a steady lane" is a bit of pitch. Spanish is natural, though "equipo" for both equipment and team blurs the headline.
